judgement.reason: Glance is a single Go web server whose config file can be added to the image with a contained Dockerfile change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the image starts with the configuration file /app/config/glance.yml (ENTRYPOINT or CMD in Dockerfile), and no Dockerfile instruction creates that file. Deployz does not mount configuration files.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile starts Glance with /app/config/glance.yml but copies only the binary, so the configuration file must be supplied from outside the image, and no shown line proves otherwise.
